scientific_intent.scientific_task: Reduce per-channel sum and sum of squares for image-like tensors.

invariants: Both reductions exact in bounded Int32 fixture.

scientific_intent.uncertainty: Integer benchmark surrogate, not a floating-point normalization pipeline.
